== Summary ==
Identified: [[Peter Davis]], Kyle McMenomy. Only Peter and Kyle in the standings; which is which not marked.

== Description ==

Game 3: [[Peter Davis]] vs Kyle McMenomy. At the [[May 2003 Columbia Heights tournament (25 May)]], Twin City Comics, Columbia Heights, Minnesota, 25 May 2003.
